name: Zephaniah
overview: Zephaniah was a male prophet in ancient Israel, uniquely identified as the son of Cushi. His prophetic ministry is noted in Scripture, where he is recognized for his role in delivering God's messages. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes beyond his prophetic identity.
namesAndTitles: The name Zephaniah means 'YHWH has hidden' or 'YHWH has hidden as a treasure,' reflecting a divine attribute of God’s protective or preserving nature. This name is a proper name mentioned explicitly in Scripture, specifically in Zephaniah 1:1.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Zephaniah was the son of Cushi, as stated in Zephaniah 1:1. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zephaniah holds significance as a prophet through whom God communicated His messages of warning and hope to His people. His identity as the son of Cushi situates him within the prophetic tradition, emphasizing his role in calling Israel to repentance and trust in God. The meaning of his name underscores the theme of divine protection that is central to his prophetic message.
